name: @red-cup-engineering/app-openai-agent-tui
description: A claude/codex-style full-screen TUI for holding a chat session with ANY OpenAI-compatible endpoint (NVIDIA, Groq, OpenAI, or a custom EndpointSpec). Each message fires a pulse: the reply is logged to the shared data mount, state is derived, and when the agent judges it necessary it dreams against a dream endpoint — continuous learning, no ticking. Assembled from @emsenn/app-tui, @emsenn/computing-with-terminal, and @emsenn/organizing-with-openai-agents.

scripts.check: npm run build:deps && npm run check:local
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:local
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
